description: Influencer social post using only 'commissionable link' as a disclosure.
content:
Obsessed with my new ClearPath card! 1.5% cash back on literally everything and the app is so easy to use.

notes: The only disclosure is 'commissionable link', which the catalog treats as inadequate: it does not tell an ordinary reader the poster is paid. No #ad, 'paid link' or 'sponsored' wording is present.
